designs.name: Dune
designs.description: Calm, tactile and made to be held. Dune is a soft river-pebble bottle in clear glass with a gentle sculptural twist, a slim brushed gold collar and a smooth travertine stone-like cap, holding a jade fragrance.

designs.name: Stilla
designs.description: Clean, quiet and confident. Stilla is a modern minimalist bottle with a soft rounded-rectangle profile, a thick weighted glass base and a travertine cap on a chrome collar, holding an aqua fragrance.

designs.name: Prism
designs.description: Sharp lines for a brand that stands out. Prism is a twisted square glass bottle in clear glass with a crisp brushed silver collar and a sculptural matte black cap, filled with peach liquid.

designs.name: Petal
designs.description: The apothecary classic, made photoreal. Petal is a Boston round dropper bottle in amber glass with a white rubber bulb, a rose gold collar and a glass pipette, holding golden oil.

designs.name: Nacre
designs.description: Packaging that feels as rich as the formula inside. Nacre is a tapered cream jar in frosted amber glass with a thick, weighted wall and base, a chrome screw lid, holding a gold balm formula.

designs.name: Haven
designs.description: Clean, quiet and confident. Haven is a modern minimalist bottle with a soft rounded-rectangle profile, a thick weighted glass base and a sand ceramic cap on a brushed silver collar, holding a pale gold fragrance.

designs.name: Versailles
designs.description: Romance and craftsmanship in one bottle. Versailles has a fluted sphere glass body with 24 vertical ribs, a rose gold beaded collar and a sculpted teardrop crystal stopper, filled with rose perfume.

designs.name: Quadra
designs.description: Sharp lines for a brand that stands out. Quadra is a tapered pyramid glass bottle in clear glass with a crisp brushed silver collar and a sculptural gloss black cap, filled with olive liquid.

designs.name: Lotus
designs.description: A modern skincare bottle built for a premium shelf. Lotus is a serum bottle in opal black glass with a chrome collar, a chrome pump head and nozzle, filled with a mint gel lotion.

designs.name: Rosehip
designs.description: The apothecary classic, made photoreal. Rosehip is a Boston round dropper bottle in clear glass with a white ribbed rubber bulb, a brushed silver collar and a glass pipette, holding amber oil.

designs.name: Celestine
designs.description: Give your fragrance the presence of a flagship scent. Celestine is a faceted crystal-glass bottle with 8-sided cuts that catch light like a gemstone, crowned by a brushed gold faceted cap and filled with amber liquid.

designs.name: Spire
designs.description: Sharp lines for a brand that stands out. Spire is a hexagonal prism glass bottle in smoked glass with a crisp brushed silver collar and a sculptural brushed silver cap, filled with lilac liquid.

designs.name: Marquise
designs.description: Romance and craftsmanship in one bottle. Marquise has a fluted amphora glass body with 16 vertical ribs, a antique brass beaded collar and a sculpted fan-shaped crystal stopper, filled with sapphire perfume.

designs.name: Chrysler
designs.description: Jazz-age glamour, rebuilt for a modern shelf. Chrysler is a octagonal glass tower with skyscraper setbacks, a crisp antique brass collar and a stepped ziggurat cap in antique brass, filled with cognac liquid.

designs.name: Tidal
designs.description: Calm, tactile and made to be held. Tidal is a soft river-pebble bottle in clear glass with a gentle sculptural twist, a slim rose gold collar and a smooth sage stone-like cap, holding a olive fragrance.

designs.name: Opaline
designs.description: Give your fragrance the presence of a flagship scent. Opaline is a faceted crystal-glass bottle with 12-sided cuts that catch light like a gemstone, crowned by a brushed gold faceted cap and filled with rose liquid.

designs.name: Nord
designs.description: Clean, quiet and confident. Nord is a modern minimalist bottle with a soft rounded-rectangle profile, a thick weighted glass base and a matte black cap on a brushed silver collar, holding a champagne fragrance.

designs.name: Monolith
designs.description: Sharp lines for a brand that stands out. Monolith is a twisted square glass bottle in smoked glass with a crisp polished gold collar and a sculptural gloss black cap, filled with sapphire liquid.

designs.name: Filigree
designs.description: Romance and craftsmanship in one bottle. Filigree has a fluted bell glass body with 24 vertical ribs, a antique brass beaded collar and a sculpted teardrop crystal stopper, filled with violet perfume.
